description: This file defines a FastAPI router for managing emoji reactions in a sports live stream platform. It includes endpoints to list emojis, submit reactions, and get reaction summaries, with related utility functions and database interactions.

classes.name: EmojiListItem
classes.description: Pydantic model for representing emoji list items with frontend-required fields.

methods.name: datetime _parse_created_at(created_at_str: str)
methods.description: Parses an ISO 8601 timestamp string into a timezone-aware datetime object, raising HTTPException if the format is invalid.

methods.name: list_emojis( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch and return a list of available emojis from the database, formatted for frontend use.

methods.name: create_emoji_reaction( reaction_request: UserEmojiReactionCaptureRequest = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user_id: str = Depends(get_current_user_id), )
methods.description: API endpoint for submitting an emoji reaction, validating input, persisting to database, and broadcasting updates via websocket.

methods.name: get_event_reactions( event_id: str, request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve the reaction summary for a specific event or match.
